baslik: The Wind Shear Warning That Went to the Wrong Frequency

sahneler.metin: A DC-9 crashed into trees and a house near Charlotte airport.
It burst into flames, and thirty seven people were killed.
A thunderstorm sat over the airport.
The tower issued a wind shear warning, but on a different frequency.
On final approach, a microburst hit the jet.
The crew tried to go around, but the plane kept sinking.
An alert system error also delayed its warning.
Wind shear detection and crew training were improved.

aciklama:
USAir 1016 crashed into trees and a house near Charlotte. The cause: microburst wind shear on approach, with alerts that came late or on another frequency.
